_instructions: This file is the single source of truth for every number, brand, campaign, testimonial and package on index.html and media-kit.html. Both pages read it when they load, so you never need to edit the HTML to update a figure.
How to update: open this file, change the value, save it, then push to GitHub. Numbers are plain integers (write 146200, not 146.2K); the pages format them for display.
meta.lastUpdated is shown on both pages as 'Updated November 2026' and should be changed whenever you refresh the figures.
Any value set to "TODO_JAMES" is hidden on the pages until you replace it with the real value. Search this file for TODO_JAMES to see what is still missing.

Case studies: 'featured': true puts a campaign in the case-study list; 'order' sets its position. Set featured to false to keep a campaign in the file without showing it. 'showEngagementRate' controls whether the engagement figure appears on that card.
Videos: 'url' is the public TikTok (or YouTube) link. When it is TODO_JAMES the card shows the caption and views but cannot be played.

Brands: 'featured' highlights a name on the brand wall, 'repeatClient' adds it to the 'Brands that came back' line, 'logo' is an optional image path (for example 'logos/sumup.svg'); the name is shown as text when logo is empty.
Testimonials: keep quotes word for word. 'logo' and 'sourceUrl' are optional and hidden while TODO_JAMES.
Packages: every package shows 'Rate on request'. There are no prices anywhere in this file on purpose.
